t: Cao Fei’s Duotopia is a trippy look into the future of technology | Dazed
s: June 1, 2023 - Building on her explorations into temporality – her 2020 exhibition Blueprints used Soviet sci-fi to upturn notions of time and space – video installation “Duotopia” opens with a quote from the Futurist manifesto: “Time and space died yesterday. We are already living in the absolute.” Built on a Chinese metaverse platform, it depicts a futuristic city atop a bionic octopus.
